name: backend
description: Node.js / Express REST API Layer for Blockchain-Based Digital Document Locker

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const src = 'dist/backend/src/server.js'; const dst = 'dist/server.js'; if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.writeFileSync(dst, 'require(\"./backend/src/server.js\");\\n'); }"
scripts.test: tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/auth.test.ts tests/ipfs.test.ts tests/documents.test.ts tests/verify.test.ts tests/audit.test.ts tests/integration.test.ts
